verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Twenty serves a structured llms.txt at docs.twenty.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its documentation. The docs pages are also published as raw .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering (e.g. an llms-full.txt or guidance on agent consumption).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.twenty.com/llms.txt # Twenty Documentation
when you add a custom object (say Invoice), it immediately gets REST and GraphQL endpoints identical to built-in objects like Company or Person.
